title: $f^*\circ p_Y^*\cong p_X^*$
statement:
Let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes. Let $f^*$ be the pullback of
abelian pro-étale sheaves along $f$, and let
$p_X^*=\pi_X^*\circ p^*$, $p_Y^*=\pi_Y^*\circ p^*$ be the inverse images from
the point ([def-sfb-finite-upper-star],
[det-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]). Since $\Spec\Z$ is terminal,
$\pi_Y\circ f=\pi_X$. The natural isomorphism
$$
f^*\circ p_Y^*=f^*\pi_Y^*p^*\ \cong\ (\pi_Y\circ f)^*p^*=\pi_X^*p^*=p_X^*
$$
is $p^*$ composed with the inverse of the composition isomorphism
$(\pi_Y\circ f)^*\cong f^*\circ\pi_Y^*$ of
[def-sfb-finite-upper-star-comp], followed by the identification
$(\pi_Y\circ f)^*=\pi_X^*$.

It is a monoidal natural isomorphism for the strong monoidal structures of
$f^*\circ p_Y^*$ and $p_X^*$ ([def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal],
[det-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]) and the tensor products of
[lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed].

proof.text: By [det-def-sfb-pullback-from-point], the functors in the statement are $p_T^*=\pi_T^*\circ p^*$ for $T=X,Y$, and $\pi_Y\circ f=\pi_X$. These are precisely the functors used in [def-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp-iso]. Take its natural isomorphism: on a condensed abelian group $F$ its component is $c_{p^*F}^{-1}$ followed by the equality identification, where $c\colon(\pi_Y\circ f)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*\circ\pi_Y^*$ is the specified composition isomorphism. Thus its direction, components, and action on morphisms agree with the construction required here.

source.place: First paragraph: the isomorphism is def-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp-iso.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-pullback-from-point-comp-monoidal] to this very comparison, rather than to an unspecified isomorphism of the same functors. Its tensor products are those of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]: sheafification of objectwise $\otimes_{\mathbf Z}$ with sheafified constant unit $\mathbf Z$. These are exactly the products $a(\iota F\otimes_p\iota G)$ and unit $a(\mathbf 1)$ in [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed] specialized to $\mathcal A=\Ab$. The inverse images have the specified strong monoidal structures of [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal] and [det-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. Hence the cited monoidality assertion gives compatibility with both the tensor comparison and the unit comparison for the structures in the statement.
